scientific_integrity: The claimed conductor formula and its four-residue corollary have an explicit self-contained argument conditional on the cited established generating-function identity. The companion checker is finite, not a proof of any infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The conductor locates the final non-divisible index and does not give termwise valuations or other-prime laws. The enumerative generating function and Catalan substitution are prior results. The initial enumeration paper was only accessible at abstract level; a potentially subsuming published deduction remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact dyadic divisibility conductors for a pattern-avoidance sequence
